QuestInfo.0: Alongside #bElwin#k and #bLily#k, you began your search for the missing #bGrendel the Really Old#k. You've arrived in #bLachelein, the Dreaming City#k.
QuestInfo.2: #bProtective Mask#k led you inside #bLucid#k's dream, where you witnessed her and #bGrendel the Really Old#k speaking about something. Grendel said something about the #rBlack Mage#k and vanished.
QuestInfo.1: In #bLachelein#k, you encountered a friendly face. #bProtective Mask#k has something to tell you at the #bClocktower#k.

no.0: Time is short, but I suppose this can wait until you've addressed your urgent matter.
